parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The region where the service is located.

parameters.name: Container
parameters.description: The name of the container in which to restart the process. This parameter is valid only when \`SoftRestart\` is set to \`true\`.

parameters.name: InstanceList
parameters.description: The instances to restart. Separate multiple instance names with a comma (,). For more information, see [ListServiceInstances](~~412108~~).

parameters.name: IsReplica
parameters.description: Specifies whether the instance is a replica.

parameters.name: ServiceName
parameters.description: The name of the service. For more information, see [ListServices](~~412109~~).

parameters.name: SoftRestart
parameters.description: Specifies whether to restart only the container process without rebuilding the instance. The default value is false.
